message.jaymospowers.pod.tow_no_line: A crashed pod can be made fast only to a pod with a tow line fitted, close by.
message.jaymospowers.pod.tow_fast: The line is made fast. Fly home: the tow burns a little more fuel and is slow.
message.jaymospowers.pod.tow_home: Your friend's pod came home on a tow line.
message.jaymospowers.pod.tow_home_only: You cannot tow a crashed pod anywhere but home.
message.jaymospowers.pod.climb: Up through the sky. Look to steer; forward to fly, sprint to boost, back to brake.
message.jaymospowers.pod.climb_auto: Up through the sky on autopilot. Press T to take the stick.
message.jaymospowers.pod.docked: Docked at the Patrol post. The console on the deck is the quartermaster's.
message.jaymospowers.pod.maw_took: The Maw took the pod. It sets down where the light is thin, and you have a return stage.
message.jaymospowers.pod.crash_back: The hull gave out. The pod limps back down where it began.
message.jaymospowers.pod.crash_on: The hull gave out. The pod limps down on the far world, its tank dry.
message.jaymospowers.patrol.post_warrant: The quartermaster logs the day's warrant against the world below.
The quartermaster has no licence of yours on file.
You already hold a warrant. Bring that one in first.
Nobody is wanted on the world below today.
message.jaymospowers.patrol.post_civilia: The quartermaster sells civilians only fuel and return stages. Modules are for officers.
screen.jaymospowers.pod_flight.skim: Skimming the Maw: hold the line
screen.jaymospowers.pod_flight.pull: The Maw is pulling you in
screen.jaymospowers.pod_flight.keys_fly: WASD steer  Shift boost  Ctrl brake  T autopilot
screen.jaymospowers.pod_flight.notice.1: Raiders in the dark: %s of them. Shoot them down or outrun them.
screen.jaymospowers.pod_flight.notice.6: Flung past the Maw. The throw saved %s fuel.
screen.jaymospowers.pod_flight.notice.11: Match speed with the wreck to strip it.
screen.jaymospowers.pod_flight.notice.15: The post is close: G to dock.
screen.jaymospowers.pod_flight.notice.16: A derelict pod drifts ahead. Slow beside it to strip it.
screen.jaymospowers.pod_flight.notice.17: A rock field. The beam reaches 24 blocks.
screen.jaymospowers.pod_flight.notice.18: The Maw lies ahead. Skim it for a sling, or give it room.
